dialogues.speaker: Ashpazi
dialogues.text: Even an idiot can cook awesome food with this fresh meat!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like some fresh meat too.

dialogues.speaker: Ashpazi
dialogues.text: Aha, looks like you know your stuff. Just pick whatever you want!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can cook?

dialogues.speaker: Ashpazi
dialogues.text: Ahem, what kind of question is that?

dialogues.speaker: Ashpazi
dialogues.text: Don't look down on my culinary expertise just because I'm wearing a Forest Watcher's uniform! I'm the renowned "Master Chef" of the Forest Rangers!

dialogues.speaker: Ashpazi
dialogues.text: ...Haha, alright, alright, that's enough jokes for now.

dialogues.speaker: Ashpazi
dialogues.text: Still, even if I'm not truly "renowned," my culinary skill is pretty extraordinary. Everyone praises it once they try it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can hunt?

dialogues.speaker: Ashpazi
dialogues.text: Of course. Where do you think the meat I sell comes from? Did you think stupid boars rush at me and ram their heads against my arrows?

dialogues.speaker: Ashpazi
dialogues.text: ...Haha, that's enough jokes. After being with Mr. Tighnari for so long, even the way he speaks has rubbed off on me.

dialogues.speaker: Ashpazi
dialogues.text: I oversee logistics for the Forest Rangers, so knowing how to hunt and cook is perfectly normal, right?

dialogues.speaker: Ashpazi
dialogues.text: In my opinion, the first step to being a good chef is to be a good hunter.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Ashpazi
dialogues.text: See you. Come again if you feel like having some meat!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't believe it.

dialogues.speaker: Ashpazi
dialogues.text: You got a problem with me, pal?

dialogues.speaker: Ashpazi
dialogues.text: But you don't look anything like an unreasonable oaf.

dialogues.speaker: Ashpazi
dialogues.text: Oh, I get it! You're using reverse psychology to get a free meal out of me!

dialogues.speaker: Ashpazi
dialogues.text: That's okay, I don't mind falling for tricks when it comes to sharing food.

dialogues.speaker: Ashpazi
dialogues.text: I have only one request. Just spread the good word about my food if you like it.
